answer: A sybil farm needs 1,000 fake voices, but each one must whisper its own name into a public registry first. First, every new identity retires one verified carbon credit, about $12, in its own legal name. Second, the registry publishes each retirement, so the same name cannot retire twice. Third, the network checks the registry before an answer counts, and a duplicate name burns the bond and ends the identity for good. Faking 1,000 agents costs $12,000 in credits plus registry checks. Like a violet flag planted once on a knoll, one credit marks one real person.
